correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed the independent squared angular-chord and axial-difference decomposition: E[A^j]=binom(2j,j)R^(2j), E[B^j]=2h^(2j)/((2j+1)(2j+2)). Hence mu=2x+y/6, nu=6x²+2xy/3+y²/15, omega=20x³+3x²y+2xy²/5+y³/28. At fixed m=mu, u=y/m lies strictly in (0,6), and kappa=(540-60u+19u²)/360 has unique minimum 26/19 at u=30/19, endpoints 3/2 and 12/5, proving all inverse multiplicity boundaries. Polynomial elimination gives y=(7581omega+23082m³-28023mnu)/(1672nu-1628m²), with denominator >=660m²; partner heights sum to 60m/19 and sixth-moment difference equals 11/945*(y1³-y2³), implying sharp 220/2527 separation. Independently checked six exact symbolic assertions (moments, rational inverse, branch constant and endpoints). The analytic positive-domain proof, not finite tests, establishes the result.
